condition: v2 claim missing identity/type/metric/subjects/protocol/evidence/status/caveats; or legacy manifest
claim_constraint: A formal PASS requires an explicit complete result_manifest.v2 claim
action: complete v2 claim fields; never silently migrate v1

condition: supported claim evidence path missing or unreadable
claim_constraint: Do not support a claim without readable explicitly cited evidence
action: fix evidence path relative to manifest or change claim status

condition: declared status conflicts with checker gate
claim_constraint: Do not label a blocked, uncertain, or incompletely proven claim supported
action: align status and caveats with gate result

condition: one or more subjects lack contiguity/BUSCO/QV/LAI/mapping/telomere evidence
claim_constraint: Do not make whole-assembly quality claims from a subset of evidence axes
action: provide all six axes for every subject

condition: selected claim record missing lineage/mode/db_version/busco_version/n_busco or result fields
claim_constraint: Do not summarize BUSCO percentages without complete lineage and software provenance
action: report lineage+mode+db_version+busco_version+n_busco with every BUSCO number

condition: comparison subjects do not share claim-selected lineage and mode
claim_constraint: Do not compare BUSCO percentages directly across lineages or modes
action: rerun same lineage/mode or report each separately

condition: high D in haplotype-resolved polyploid assembly
claim_constraint: Duplicated BUSCO is not automatically a defect
action: check ploidy/subgenome context before calling over-duplication
source: hifiasm primary docs / quinoa V2 context

condition: selected record missing k/read_db_type/coverage/independence/QV
claim_constraint: Do not state publication QV without truth-set provenance
action: report k+read_db_type+coverage+independence+QV

condition: comparison subjects differ in k or read_db_type from claim protocol
claim_constraint: Do not rank QV across different k or truth-set types
action: harmonize k and read database type or report separately

condition: read database is not independent of assembly input
claim_constraint: QV is not an independent validation under this protocol
action: prefer orthogonal PCR-free short reads and carry a non-independence caveat

condition: total_LTR_RT_pct<5 or intact_LTR_RT_pct<0.1; or selected LAI evidence absent
claim_constraint: Do not use an inapplicable or absent LAI grade as quality evidence
action: mark LAI not_applicable or provide validated evidence

condition: LAI used as cross-organism quality grade
claim_constraint: LAI grade labels are not directly portable across taxa
action: prefer within-organism and same-method comparison

condition: BUSCO_C>=98 and LAI<10
claim_constraint: Gene-space completeness does not imply repeat-space completeness
action: report the two evidence axes separately

condition: claim mixes contig_N50 and scaffold_N50 or a subject lacks selected type
claim_constraint: Do not compare continuity values of different types
action: select protocol.n50_type and require it for every subject

condition: scaffold_N50 lacks misjoin validation
claim_constraint: Scaffolding can inflate N50 through false joins
action: require contact/read structural validation

condition: pilot_only or full_count_incomplete
claim_constraint: Do not make population association claims from pilot/partial counts
action: mark exploratory until full route completes

condition: hit overlaps SD or centromere
claim_constraint: Causal phrasing is unsupported without unique mappability evidence
action: require unique mappability evidence or exclude region

condition: high-confidence claim lacks read and assembly evidence axes
claim_constraint: Do not call SV high-confidence without orthogonal read+assembly support
action: provide at least one caller/evidence source on each axis

condition: sample metadata/design/contrast/strandedness not explicit
claim_constraint: Do not infer a DE comparison from filenames or prose
action: provide validated sample metadata, design formula, contrast, and strandedness

condition: contrasted group has <2 biological replicates or exactly 2
claim_constraint: No population inference without replication; n=2 remains fragile
action: block n<2; warn n=2; prefer >=3 biological replicates

condition: DE input is not raw integer counts or strandedness invalid
claim_constraint: TPM/FPKM and ambiguous counting semantics are not DESeq2 count input
action: use raw integer gene counts with validated strandedness

condition: batch and condition fully confounded or not explicitly cleared
claim_constraint: The requested condition effect is not identifiable
action: redesign/obtain balanced samples or limit claim scope

condition: FDR/effect/shrinkage/QC evidence or explicit files missing
claim_constraint: Do not support DE without multiple-testing, effect-size, and sample/count QC provenance
action: provide BH-FDR/effect/shrinkage and readable metadata/count/QC paths

condition: reference/ploidy/caller/calling-mode/multiallelic provenance missing
claim_constraint: Do not validate a callset without reference and ploidy assumptions
action: record reference checksum, ploidy, caller/version, mode, and multiallelic policy

condition: sample IDs do not explicitly match
claim_constraint: Do not combine BAM/VCF/manifest samples with unresolved identities
action: reconcile canonical sample IDs and document exclusions

condition: normalization or filter provenance incomplete
claim_constraint: Do not use an unnormalized or irreproducibly filtered callset
action: record left alignment, splitting tool/version, and thresholds

condition: VCF/reference/sample manifest/index path missing or unreadable
claim_constraint: A population callset claim needs accessible indexed evidence
action: provide readable explicit paths; never infer by directory scan

condition: phenotype and genotype sample IDs do not explicitly match
claim_constraint: Do not run association with unresolved sample identities
action: reconcile samples and document exclusions

condition: ploidy/genetic model incompatible with selected engine
claim_constraint: Diploid/disomic engines cannot silently analyze dosage/non-disomic genotypes
action: validate D assumptions or select and validate a P-route engine

condition: QC thresholds/PCA/kinship/covariates or readable evidence missing
claim_constraint: Do not support GWAS without genotype QC and population-structure control
action: provide explicit thresholds, PCA, kinship, covariates, and input paths

condition: multiple-testing/QQ/effect-allele evidence missing
claim_constraint: Do not report significant hits without calibrated inference and allele direction
action: record correction threshold, QQ evidence, and effect allele
